title: Event homelabnext.agent.job.failed
description: An agent job (one run in the orchestration controller's queue) reached a terminal failure. Published by the controller through the forwarder; StackStorm's job-failed rule (A02, docs/stackstorm.md) reacts by resubmitting through the controller queue, bounded by resubmits. The id derives from the run id, so a re-sent failure is a duplicate. reason is the controller's failure class: capacity, stall, timeout and backend-down are faults of the environment; deadline, cancelled, turn-cap and budget are decisions that must not be retried; handler-error and unknown are the job's own failure.

reason.description: the failure class the controller recorded (the same value as failure_class): stall, backend-down, capacity and timeout are resubmittable, the rest never

attempts.description: attempts made inside this run (the profile's max_attempts chain)

resubmits.description: how many whole-job resubmits precede this run in its retry_of_run_id lineage (0 = an original submit)

failure_class.description: the controller's failure class; equal to reason (kept for consumers that read the controller's own field name)

retried_by_run_id.description: set once the run was retried: by the scheduler itself (auto_retry_scheduled) or by an accepted resubmit; it will not take another

auto_retry_scheduled.description: present (and true) only when the scheduler auto-retried this run in the same transaction; omitted otherwise

profile_revision_drift.description: present (and true) only when the agent profile's revision changed while the run was queued or running; omitted otherwise
